name: social-publisher
description: Fail-closed Instagram and Threads publisher for GitHub Actions

scripts.sample: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js sample
scripts.demo: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js demo
scripts.preview: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js preview
scripts.validate: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js validate
scripts.publish: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js publish
scripts.reconcile: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js reconcile
scripts.recover: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js recover
scripts.retry-failed: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js retry-failed
scripts.state:init: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js state:init
scripts.assets:prepare: npm run build --silent && node dist/runner.js prepare-assets
scripts.assets:save-manifests: npm run build --silent && node dist/runner.js save-asset-manifests
scripts.assets:report: npm run build --silent && node dist/runner.js report-assets
